about: Community compatibility list for UniView. Key = the game's install folder name (e.g. steamapps/common/<this>). status: works | partial | broken. Add or update a game with a pull request, or right-click a game in UniView -> 'Report compatibility...' to open an issue.

Among Us.notes: Mostly a 2D game: 143k sprites and 2.3k textures all load. The few 3D meshes have no linked textures.

BattleBit Remastered.notes: Loads fully. Only about 1 in 4 models finds its texture automatically, so apply textures from the list by hand.

Car Mechanic Simulator 2018.notes: Loads fully and most models find their textures automatically. A few meshes are stripped (no vertex data).

Fallout Shelter.notes: Most models find their textures automatically. A few meshes are stripped (no vertex data).

Mage Arena.notes: Loads fully and most models find their textures. A few 'Font Texture' entries are empty (made while the game runs).

Make Way.notes: Everything loads. About half the models find their texture automatically.

Megabonk.notes: Everything loads. About 40% of models find their texture automatically, and a few meshes are stripped.

Muck.notes: Everything loads. Some models need their texture applied by hand, and a few meshes are only lines/points (skipped).

PapersPlease.notes: A 2D game: the textures and sprites are the interesting part. There are only 13 simple meshes.

Probably Stolen Playtest.notes: Mostly 2D: about 2k sprites and 870 textures load fine.

Robocraft.notes: Models, textures and sprites all load, and most models find their texture automatically. Textures keep mask data in alpha, so leave 'Texture alpha' off.

Schedule I.notes: Loads fully. About 40% of models find their texture automatically.

Trailmakers.notes: Big game (447 files, about 33k models), so it takes around 2 minutes to load. A few sprites come from atlases built while the game runs and can't be shown.

Unturned.notes: Everything loads and most models find their textures automatically.

Valheim.notes: 645 files, loads in about a minute. Nearly all models find their textures automatically.
